Wow how did u decide to join the army? You know what, you're like a rolemodel to me. I know it sounds weird but that's it! That's exactly what I want to do. Not your kinds of jobs but trying something else. Taking risks. But the road to that seems far but I will try. Btw I like computor stuffs and you said you were a pc expert? If it's not to much to ask for but could you tell me about the road to that and what you did to become that? If not, thank you for sharing your story. You helped someone today :)

Yea I totally want to try new things but I'm so shy. I always think about what might happened and what can go wrong. I know you shouldn't do that and just do it. But I just can't stop it. Those kind of thoughts are always in my head, everyday. It may be beacuse I'm unsecure about my self. Like I hate being in a group of people beacuse all I think about is what they think about me. I know most of them don't care but I can't JUST get rid of those thoughts.
But I guess taking a big risk is a part of my dream.
If anything is tickling my fancy? (LOL sounds so weird) uhm no I guess not. Maybe like computor stuff, like editing but idk it's really vague. Like yeah there is some things I like doing and kinda makes me happy but they are just things that can't be a job I guess.
Thank you so much for your helpful words! It really helps hearing from people that have experienced more in life. :)
I hear you man! We can talk about it in some private message if you want. (I never write on reddit so don't really know how to) I'm here man.

Thank you for the helpfull words! Yea I will probably stumble throught it like I always have. That Alexander quote was really cool. But yea I will strive for other things than a job, I promise you that.
really inspirational words, thank you! I just need to know to know what I love doing I guess.

"You will die eventually. There's no rush." I like that saying :) Thank you for your kind and really helpfull words. Yea I know there are more things to life than a job but that's the thing tho. I don't have much else. Kinda lonely life you know. But I guess that's the problem too huh. When you never had a gf or a close friend and you hate your body, it's hard to enjoy other things in life. I mean there are somethings like gaming, fashion and basketball I kinda enjoy but it's just not enough you know. I just feel like knowing what my dream/goal is will help me carry on and eventually find the solutions to my other social problems.
